name.en: PETS (Public English Test System) registration photo
name.zh: 全国英语等级考试报名照

notes.en: NEEA candidate notice: recent (within 6 months) front-facing bareheaded ID photo; white or blue background; 33 mm wide × 48 mm high; head occupies 2/3 of the photo height; file size 10–50 KB. File format, pixels, DPI, and colour vs grayscale are not stated.
notes.zh: 教育部教育考试院考生须知：近 6 个月内正面免冠证件照，白底或蓝底，宽 33 mm、高 48 mm，头部占照片长度的 2/3，文件 10K–50K。未写格式、像素、DPI 及是否必须彩色。
